summary.en: An aspiring novelist named Shokichi Hazama is talking to Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys while he is carrying the items bought from the shop. At the residence Hazama is living in, he sees the conversation between the apartment landlady Teruyo Imaizumi and one of his neighbors Nenji Kodakara. It turns out that Kodokara’s apartment has been stolen but Imaizumi does not let him call the police because it would affect the reputation of the apartment. They decide to call them, nonetheless.
